extraction.name: Self-Contradictory Instructions
extraction.description: The Self-Contradictory Instructions (SCI) benchmark evaluates the capability of large multimodal models in recognizing conflicting commands. It comprises 20,000 conflicts, evenly distributed between language and vision paradigms.
extraction.creator: Jin Gao (Shanghai Jiao Tong University); Lei Gan (Fudan University); Yuankai Li (Fudan University); Yixin Ye (Shanghai Jiao Tong University); Dequan Wang (Shanghai Jiao Tong University; Shanghai Artificial Intelligence Laboratory)
extraction.citeAs: Jin Gao, Lei Gan, Yuankai Li, Yixin Ye, and Dequan Wang. Dissecting Dissonance: Benchmarking Large Multimodal Models Against Self-Contradictory Instructions. arXiv:2408.01091v2, 2024.
extraction.rai:dataCollection: The dataset was automatically generated using a framework called AutoCreate, which leverages Large Language Models (LLMs) to generate data from a small batch of manually input seeds through a cyclic process of generation, decoration, and cleaning. For the SemanticConflict task, images were retrieved from the ImageNet dataset.
extraction.rai:dataCollectionRawData: The raw data consists of a small batch of manually input seeds used to prompt the LLMs, and images retrieved from the external ImageNet dataset for the SemanticConflict task.
extraction.rai:dataAnnotationProtocol: The dataset was automatically generated using the AutoCreate framework, where Large Language Models (LLMs) generate data from manual seeds, introduce conflicts, and clean the data, followed by a quality check by human experts and LLMs.
extraction.rai:dataAnnotationAnalysis: An automated Cleaner removes data that does not meet quality standards, and both human experts and LLMs double-check the quality of the generated dataset.
extraction.rai:dataLimitations: only include language-language and vision-language paradigms; no fine-grained control is introduced to determine the conflict degree; we do not provide a detailed study on the attention mechanism of large multimodal models when confronted with conflict instructions
extraction.rai:dataSocialImpact: It provides researchers and practitioners with a standardized platform to assess and enhance LMMs' ability to navigate conflicting instructions, advancing human-computer interaction and communication technologies. The AutoCreate framework facilitates the creation of diverse instruction datasets, promoting inclusivity in AI research. Additionally, the CaP approach integrates external cognition into multimodal models, enhancing context-aware understanding. By improving dissonance detection, our approach boosts LMM performance and fosters trust and reliability in AI systems, essential for societal integration.
extraction.rai:dataUseCases: evaluate the capability of LMMs in recognizing conflicting commands; assess and enhance LMMs' ability to navigate conflicting instructions
extraction.rai:dataManipulationProtocol: The dataset is synthetically generated and manipulated using a 'Decorator' module that introduces self-contradictions into the data. Specific manipulations include modifying image captions to introduce conflicts, changing maximum numerical values to minimum values to tamper with data dictionaries, modifying phrases to refer to non-existent objects, and substituting correct class labels with similar but different objects.
extraction.rai:dataPreprocessingProtocol: A 'Cleaner' module is used to remove data that does not meet quality standards, followed by a quality check by human experts and LLMs.
